infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NEXORA uses your location to plan multimodal routes, find nearby transit stops, and warn about road hazards.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NEXORA records meetings and calls with your explicit consent for transcript, commitment, and evidence sealing.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: NEXORA matches incoming caller handles against your contacts locally to identify callers without paid third-party SDKs.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow NEXORA to access your location for live multimodal routing and road hazard alerts.
